user.title: Configure Heating System
user.description: Welcome to Zoned Heating Thermostat setup wizard. Enter your heating system name.

zones.title: Create Zones
zones.description: Define zones separated by commas (e.g. 'Ground Floor, First Floor'). Each zone will manage an independent pump.

zone_rooms.title: Rooms for {zone_name}
zone_rooms.description: Enter room names belonging to {zone_name} separated by commas (e.g. 'Living Room, Kitchen, Office').

configure_room.title: Sensors for {room_name} ({zone_name})
configure_room.description: Select the primary room temperature sensor, associated TRVs and optional window sensor.

pumps.title: Assign Circulation Pumps
pumps.description: Select the switch/relay for each zone's circulation pump.

summary.title: Configuration Summary

error.no_zones_defined: You must specify at least one zone.
error.no_rooms_defined: You must specify at least one room for this zone.

data.startup_delay: Pump Startup Delay (seconds, waits for TRV to open)
